description: Cross-platform Desktop Application for Metadata Inspection/Stripping, Image, Video & Audio Operations, AI Redaction, and Media Conversion.

tech_stack.frontend: HTML5, Vanilla CSS (styles.css), JavaScript ES Modules

external_binaries.ffmpeg: bin/{mac,win}/ffmpeg - Video trimming, cropping, muting, blurring, and format conversion
external_binaries.ffprobe: bin/{mac,win}/ffprobe - Media stream analysis and duration probe
external_binaries.exiftool: bin/{mac,win}/exiftool - Detailed metadata extraction and stripping

ai_engine.function: Automated object, face, and license plate redaction using YOLOv8

libraries: Cropper.js (Interactive cropping, rotation, and blur boundary selection)

ui_architecture.main_layout: Single-window, multi-workspace architecture in index.html with single-pane RHS options panel

sidebars.middle_pane: Media player, main image canvas, or metadata inspector workspace
sidebars.right_sidebar: Contextual editing tools panel (displaces standard window when 'Edit' is clicked, includes top 'Back to normal' button)

metadata_studio.description: Inspect and clean EXIF/GPS/hardware metadata from image files
features: Interactive directory file tree browser
Comprehensive EXIF metadata key-value table extraction via ExifTool
Image thumbnail preview
Single file metadata stripping
Batch folder metadata stripping with backup option

image_editor.description: Full image editing, manual & automated AI redaction suite
features: Interactive Crop with freeform & fixed aspect ratio presets
Rotation (clockwise/counter-clockwise) and horizontal/vertical flip
Straighten adjustment control
Manual Blur / Pixelation region drawing
Automated AI Redaction via YOLOv8 (detects faces, plates, sensitive objects)
Bulk Auto-Redaction (Batch face detection and redaction across selected files/folders via #dd-bulk-redact with mode choices: Blur, Black Box, White Box)
Save options: 'Replace Original' (with auto-backup) or 'Save as New File'
UI loading state feedback on Save button during processing

video_editor.description: Video trimming, cropping, bulk muting, and time-frame blur suite
features: Icon-only Edit Video button (movie_edit icon)
Precise Video Trimming (trimStart & trimEnd inputs with video time markers)
Visual Video Crop (Cropper.js overlay; automatically enforces even output width/height for FFmpeg libx264 compatibility)
Audio Muting (Single video mute toggle & Bulk Mute feature via #dd-bulk-mute for selected files/folders)
Bulk Frame Extraction (Extract specific frame number across selected files/folders into dedicated named folders via #dd-bulk-frame)
Video Blur Overlay (Full video blur or timeframe-specific blur with start/end duration inputs)
Dynamic FFmpeg Boxblur Engine (Automatically calculates luma & chroma radii based on crop box dimensions to prevent FFmpeg crashes on small selections)
Live Blur Preview (Real-time HTML/CSS overlay with backdrop-filter: blur(15px) positioned over video player, tracking video playback timestamp & zoom)
Automated AI Face Redaction (YOLOv8 & OpenCV frame-by-frame tracking & blurring across the video, preserving original audio)
Save options: 'Replace Original' or 'Save as New File' with UI loading feedback state ('Saving...')

audio_operations.description: Audio file browser, playback, editing, and BHASHINI transcription workspace
features: Audio-only directory tree with nested folder navigation
Folder path input and drag-and-drop loading
Keyboard-accessible file and folder navigation
Selected-file format and size details
Decoded waveform generated from the selected audio file
Custom playback controls with play/pause, 10-second skip, speed, mute, time display, and waveform seeking
Precise audio trimming with draggable waveform start/end handles, playhead-based boundary capture, range highlighting, selection preview, and replace-or-export save options
Continuous pointer scrubbing by clicking and dragging across the waveform
Opt-in BHASHINI speech-to-text panel with runtime-only Udyat and inference credentials
English and 22 Indian transcription languages using language-appropriate BHASHINI ASR services
Copy transcript and export transcript as a text file

media_converter.description: Batch image and video format converter
features: Multi-format image conversion (.png, .jpg, .webp, .tiff, etc.)
Multi-format video transcode (.mp4, .mkv, .avi, .webm, .mov, etc.)
Real-time conversion progress bar (js/progress.js) receiving IPC updates from main process

channels: save-image: Handles canvas data write & file saving
save-video: Executes FFmpeg filter complex pipelines for trim, crop, blur, mute, and save
strip-metadata: Calls ExifTool binary for single/batch metadata removal
convert-file: Spawns FFmpeg for format conversions
yolo-redact: Spawns Python process running yolo_redact.py for AI redaction
bulk-mute-videos: Strips audio tracks across multiple selected videos
bulk-extract-frame: Extracts a specific frame number from multiple videos into dedicated folders
bulk-redact-images: Performs batch AI face redaction across multiple selected image files with progress tracking and cancelation
get-file-url: Creates a safe local file URL for media preview
read-audio-buffer: Reads a selected audio file for waveform decoding with a 200 MB safety limit
trim-audio: Uses FFmpeg to trim and re-encode a selected audio range with safe original-file replacement
transcribe-audio: Normalizes audio to mono 16 kHz FLAC and sends it to BHASHINI without persisting credentials
save-transcript: Exports generated transcription text through a native save dialog

file_structure.main.js: Electron main entry point & IPC backend handlers
file_structure.index.html: Main UI structure containing all workspaces & side panels
file_structure.styles.css: Global design system, dark theme, layout rules, custom dropdowns, and animations
file_structure.js/video-editor.js: Video editor workspace frontend logic & live blur preview
file_structure.js/audio.js: Audio operations workspace browser and playback preview logic
file_structure.yolo_redact.py: Python script for YOLOv8 AI object detection and redaction
